title: Rocket Roadster Risk Quote
one_liner: A tongue-in-cheek insurance calculator for cars with strapped-on rocket thrusters and 2G fan-suction levitation.
headline: Pick a trim (or build your own rocket car), flip on thrusters and upside-down flight, and watch a joke insurance quote and risk gauge break in real time.

episode.title: Flying Tesla Car, Robot Brains Halving in Cost Every 3 Weeks, and Why Incentives Decide AI Alignment | #303

history.summary: A tight, well-executed satire that nails the podcast bit: three preset trims plus a custom slider mode, live-recalculated premium, dynamic exclusions, and a gauge that visibly "breaks" once risk exceeds 100%. Copy is funny and consistent, honesty labeling is clear, and the code is small, dependency-free vanilla JS/CSS that's easy to follow.
